# CI-tools: Copilot entry point

This repository provides reusable GitHub Actions workflows, composite actions,
and Python utilities for CI across MiraGeoscience projects.

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for repository structure, working agreements,
validation commands, and the instruction index.

Detailed policies live in [.github/instructions](instructions/): adding tools,
code review, and security review. Use the files relevant to the changed paths
and task; keep this entry point a summary rather than duplicating those rules.
Skills are for repeatable task procedures, not a replacement for these policies.
